Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the Puget Sound scientific research account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a Puget Sound scientific researchaccount; adding a new section to chapter 90.71 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Although research about the conditions inPuget Sound have been studied during the past several decades, thelegislature finds that there is no coordinated, focused, comprehensivePuget Sound science program capable of setting research priorities forPuget Sound science. The legislature finds that environmental problemsin Puget Sound are complex and research is needed to provideinformation that can guide protective and restorative actions, and toexplore and understand the impacts of a changing environment. Thelegislature also finds that there is no predictable funding process forPuget Sound research projects, including the aquatic rehabilitationzone one. The legislature declares that the state needs a process tofocus the scientific effort on the Puget Sound ecosystem and todistribute research funds.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The action team or its successor agency shall: (a) Identify gaps in science related to: (i) The restoration of the aquatic rehabilitation zone one, createdin RCW 90.88.010; (ii) Puget Sound environmental protection; and (iii) Puget Sound environmental restoration; (b) Formulate a research plan that narrows key science researchgaps identified in (a) of this subsection; (c) Develop a competitive process for soliciting research on PugetSound and on the aquatic rehabilitation zone one; (d) Solicit and strategically prioritize research programs andprojects in accordance with (b) and (c) of this subsection.Prioritization shall be determined by criteria that result in thegreatest preservation or restoration progress; (e) Select and fund the highest priority research programs andprojects identified under (d) of this subsection; and (f) Develop and implement an appropriate peer review process toreview results from the research programs and projects selected andfunded under (e) of this subsection. (2) The Puget Sound scientific research account is created in thestate treasury. All gifts, grants, federal moneys, or appropriationsmade to the account must be deposited into the account. Moneys in theaccount may be spent only after appropriation. Expenditures from theaccount may be used only for research programs and projects for thepurposes of subsection (1) of this section.
